issue_request: FHIR-41232 was an Applied/Persuasive PA change request for R6 asking that ChargeItem.reason become 0..* CodeableReference(Condition | DiagnosticReport | Observation | ImmunizationRecommendation | Procedure), while retaining the existing example ICD-10 value set binding.
initial_application: The request was applied in core by commit 54ef8dc2ad6dbfe5ed6bcbf08e03e3f05812041e, which changed source/chargeitem/structuredefinition-ChargeItem.xml from CodeableConcept to CodeableReference and added the five requested target profiles while keeping the ICD-10 example binding.
additional_context: ChargeItem is no longer an active resource in this core checkout. Current source/fhir.ini has no ChargeItem entry in the active [resources] list, core module pages link ChargeItem to the Admin Incubator build, and commit 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36 removed the ChargeItem and ChargeItemDefinition source files from core. The residual library model-definition content is a FHIR 4.0.0 example, not current R6 ChargeItem source.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The current Admin Incubator StructureDefinition-ChargeItem.json defines ChargeItem.reason as CodeableReference with target profiles for Condition, DiagnosticReport, Observation, ImmunizationRecommendation, and Procedure, and keeps the example ICD-10 binding.
